description: The quiet backbone food species of the Feywood. Hearthnut produces the nuts, oil, meal, and flour-equivalent that sustain elven subsistence through winter. Hearthnut groves are tended at Thornveil, Vaelmere, noble estates, and the Feywood Edge; the species is central to elven food culture in a way realm observers often underestimate.

ecology.cultural_role: winter food-security staple; flour, meal, oil
ecology.ecological_role: major nut producer; canopy squirrel and songbird forage

name: Hearthnut Grove Tree
